flows.title: Set up a Position Tracking campaign
steps: Open the Position Tracking tool from the left-hand menu.

When you create your first folder in Semrush, Position Tracking is automatically configured and launched for the domain you provided. For any subsequent folders, create a new folder from Position Tracking and follow the prompts to configure it.
The configuration consists of two steps: Targeting and Keywords.
In the first step you set the scope. By default the scope is the whole domain (Root domain), but you can narrow your focus to a root domain, subdomain, URL or subfolder.
Choose the search engine. By default it is set to Google, but you can also choose Bing, Baidu, ChatGPT or Google AI Mode.
Select one device based on your goals, since search results are different across desktop, mobile phones and tablets. Availability depends on the search engine you select.
Choose the location. You can track results specific to a country, state or region, city, or even a zip code; after you pick a location you may get an option to choose the language.
You can also enter your Business name in this step to track local pack results for your website.
On the second step, add the keywords to the campaign: manually, from Semrush reports, from Keyword Strategy Builder, from Google Analytics, from Google Search Console, or from a .txt or .csv file.
Once you've added your keywords to track, click on the green button Start Tracking. The tool will need some time to gather data for your campaign.
Group your keywords by different topics with tags, which you can add from the initial setup window separated by commas, or later from the settings or directly from the Position Tracking report.
